intro: A three-minute checkpoint on the first half of this module, in your own AI assistant with voice on: what would have happened if, and why things are as they are. The tutor describes a situation that went wrong and asks Was hätte man anders machen können? and Was wäre passiert, wenn …?, then asks for causes and circumstances so that you need wegen, trotz, infolge and innerhalb with the genitive. It listens for the past Konjunktiv on both sides of a wenn-sentence (hätte / wäre + participle), for the double infinitive with a modal (hätte … können / sollen), and for genitives after the prepositions. Speak in full sentences; say 'Ende' if you need to stop early.
tips[0].title: Answer 'was hätte man …' with hätte … können / sollen
tips[0].text: Man hätte früher anfangen sollen. Man hätte die Kosten senken können. Modal last, as an infinitive.
tips[0].check.why: With hätte plus another infinitive, the modal stays an infinitive at the very end: hätten … buchen sollen.
tips[1].title: Causes with the genitive
tips[1].text: Wegen des schlechten Wetters … Trotz der hohen Kosten … Aufgrund der Ergebnisse … Say the genitive article and the noun's -s where it belongs.
tips[1].check.why: wegen takes the genitive: des starken Regens, with -s on the noun.
remember[0]: Wenn … gewusst hätte, wäre … / Man hätte … sollen.
remember[1]: wegen des, trotz der, innerhalb eines.
hook: Talk through a plan that went wrong: what should have been done, what would have happened, and why.
